queries.title: Count paid events
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE kind = 'paid';

notes: Page 1 holds the file header; SQLite reads it at the start of every statement to check whether the file changed since its last look.
Reads are what SQLite asked the file for with its own page cache at the minimum size, so almost every page reference is visible. Writes are logged when the statement commits.
Rows show each page as it was right after setup, before any query ran.
The database was rebuilt with VACUUM after setup, so each table and index sits in one run of pages. Capture it without --vacuum to compare the layout it grew into.
